title: SPACE, and the trap of measuring an individual’s productivity

videos.script: Sooner or later somebody above you asks a simple question. Which of your developers is the most productive? {{question}} The numbers seem to be right there. Every commit has an author. Every item has a name on it. {{numbers}} Sum them per person, and you have a ranking in a minute. {{ranking}} It is the most damaging thing you can do with this data. {{damaging}} The work that makes a team fast is mostly invisible at the level of one person. Reviewing. Unblocking. Pairing. Getting up at two in the morning. {{invisible}} Rank people by items finished, and they stop doing all of it. {{stop}} This lesson uses a framework called SPACE. Five dimensions of productivity, for teams, not for ranking people. {{space}} It ends with what a tech lead does instead, when somebody asks that question. {{instead}}
